THE GROUND

Hill — striking FROM a hill: +1 damage
Forest — −1 damage taken standing in it · costs 2 movement to enter (Scouts ignore)
Mana Font — a great mage standing here gains +1 extra mana each round · spells cast from a Font cost ◆1 less (min ◆1)

SPELLTHRONE

Two archmages. One floating island. The throne is listening.

Spellthrone v3.17 · Slice 3.17 — Courts & Longevity — nine pieces a side on a wider isle: two great mages, Guardians who step in, fires that spread and frosts that root, and a Deepening at Round 5. A piece still to act wears a ring of light; once it has acted, the ring is gone and the piece rests dimmer. Orbit low and the island’s under-rock is lit from below now, mana seams glowing in the dark. The court breathes: pieces idle on their own time, rise when chosen, and flash when struck. And the Exclusives are serpents now — Ember's Cinderwyrm and Frost's Rimewyrm coil where the hounds once ran, forked tongues and all — while the archers stand in a true shooter's stance, arrows level. And the air itself has taken sides: embers rise over Ember's half of the isle while snow sifts down over Frost's, the braziers' firelight dances with their own flames, and gold, ice and plate catch real reflections of the dusk. The camera has learned manners too: four preset views fly you smoothly around the court, and left alone it breathes, very slowly, like something alive. On the board, pieces travel like they mean it now: moves glide hex to hex on an eased arc, strikes lunge and recoil, and the fallen shrink into their burst of court-colored sparks. And the wyrms themselves have been taken down a size — a small trim, so the serpents coil beside the band instead of towering over it. Learn it in a minute. Master it in a season.

CHOOSE YOUR COURT

HOW TO PLAY

The duel. You command an Archmage, a High Mage and seven followers on a wide hex island. Players alternate activating one piece per turn — move, then strike or cast (or stay and act). When every piece has acted the round ends: crowns are counted, mana flows, everyone refreshes. Combat never rolls dice — the numbers are always exactly what you see. Mastery is positioning.

🏆 Two ways to win. Slay the enemy Archmage — or hold the golden Throne at the island's heart: end a round as its sole holder, three times. Crowns are counted from Round 3 — the first two rounds belong to the armies. If 24 rounds pass with no victor, the crowns decide; tied crowns fall to the stronger warband.

YOUR WARBAND

🔮 Archmage 10 HP
Casts the court's book and bolts foes for 2 at range 2–3. If he falls, you lose.
👑 High Mage 8 HP
The queen: her own two spells and a bolt at range 2–4. While both great mages stand, either can cast the court's Resonance pair. Her fall ends Resonance — not the duel.
🗿 Guardian 10–11 HP
A walking wall. Hits for 3 in melee; allies beside one take −1 damage; and once a round a Guardian can Intercept — take a hit meant for a neighbor (the defender chooses, seeing the damage). Ember's Pyre Guard bites back for 1; Frost's Bulwark (11 HP) chills whatever strikes it or its aura.
🏹 Skirmisher 5 HP
Shoots for 2 at range 2–3, never point-blank. Ember's Cinderbow primes Burning and, standing still, looses a Volley at a second foe; Frost's Shardbow chills — and standing still, its shot drives the cold deeper: a foe already Chilled is Rooted where they stand (Still Aim). A fresh foe is only Chilled.
🧚 Scout 5 HP
Flits 4 hexes through forests as if they were air; stings for 1 and needles at range 2. Ember's Spark Sprite bursts on death; Frost's Mist Sprite, in a forest, cannot be targeted by ranged fire beyond 2 hexes while no enemy stands adjacent.
🕯️ Enabler 6 HP
Points outward, never heals. Ember's Kindlebrand lights an ally's next attack (+1, primes Burning); Frost's Rimewarden wraps an ally in ice — the Ward: the next hit they take is negated. But great mages burn too bright to hold a ward, so no Archmage or High Mage may be warded.
🐍 Court Exclusive 6–7 HP
Ember's Cinderwyrm: a coiled serpent of stone plate and magma — fast, +1 vs Burning prey, runs farther toward fire. Frost's Rimewyrm: a serpent of ice plate over glacier light — its hits chill, +1 vs Chilled, +1 more vs Rooted.
▲ The triangle
Classes circle: Scout +1 dmg vs Skirmisher · Guardian +1 dmg vs Scout · Skirmisher pins Guardians (a pinned Guardian cannot Intercept that round; his aura never sleeps). Bonus-only — the favored hit wears a ▲ on the target's number.

THE GROUND

Hill (raised, rocky) — striking FROM a hill: +1 damage
Forest (trees) — −1 damage taken standing in it · costs 2 movement to enter (Scouts ignore the cost)
Mana Font (violet crystals) — a great mage standing here gains +1 extra mana each round, on top of the usual +1 — and spells cast while standing on one cost ◆1 less (never below ◆1). Fonts are casting platforms: the spell buttons show the font price while a caster stands there. Six fonts: a home pair per court, and a contested pair on the rims.
Throne (gold, center) — end a round as its sole holder, 3 times, to win · crowns count from Round 3
Heart Crystal — deep in each home burns the enemy element's crystal: a dormant objective, the Scout's pilgrimage in a later lesson. Guard the ground around yours.

SPELLS — THE GREAT MAGES CAST

Ember's book: 🔥 Fireball ◆3 (3 to a hex, 1 around it, friends included) · 🌋 Wildfire ◆3 (fire leaps: enemies beside a Burning piece take 1 and catch) · ♨️ Overheat ◆2 (your piece takes 1; its next attack +2) · 💚 Mend ◆2. The High Mage carries 🔥 Cinderlance ◆2 and 🏷️ Pyrebrand ◆1.

Frost's book: 🧊 Frost Lance ◆2 (2 damage + Chill) · 🔨 Brittle ◆2 (3 vs Chilled and consumes it, else 1) · 🏔️ Glacier ◆4 (an ice wall: blocks movement, 2 rounds) · 💚 Mend ◆2. The High Mage carries ❄️ Shardspray ◆2 and 🥶 Coldsnap ◆1.

Resonance (either great mage, only while both live): Ember — ☄️ Conflagration ◆5, 🎇 Mass Ignite ◆4. Frost — 🥶 Deep Freeze ◆5, 🧱 Glacier Field ◆4.

Signatures (once per game, sealed until the Deepening at Round 5): 🌠 Meteor ◆5 (Ember) · 🌡️ Absolute Zero ◆6 (Frost).

Burning & Chill. Every Ember attack primes Burning: 1 damage at the start of the burning piece's own activation; marks fade at round's end. Every Frost attack applies Chill: −1 movement on the victim's next activation; 2 Chill means Rooted — no movement at all. Neither ever stuns.

Spells ignore hills, woods and auras — raw magic answers to nothing (but a Rimewarden's ward eats any single hit, spell or steel). Mana: you start with ◆3 and gain +1 each round (+1 more with your Archmage on a Mana Font, +1 more after the Deepening), up to ◆8. Casting from a Mana Font costs ◆1 less (minimum ◆1).

That is the whole game. The rest — tempo, traps, throne pressure, when to bank mana and when to burn it — is the mastery. New here? The 🎓 Tutorial on the menu teaches all of it at the board.
